parsed.internal_thinking: I just built a settlement on node 9, which gives me a 3:1 port and access to Wood (12) and Sheep (8). My current resources are 3 Wood and 3 Sheep. I cannot build a road or anything else this turn because I lack Brick. Charlie and Bob have been trading, which is a concern. My next logical step is to expand toward node 18 (Sheep 8, Brick 10) to secure a reliable Brick source and more Sheep, or move toward Ore. Since I can't take any build actions, I will end my turn.
